title: Flexible iontronic sensing
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4651-4700
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00870G, Review Article
Yang Li, Ningning Bai, Yu Chang, Zhiguang Liu, Jianwen Liu, Xiaoqin Li, Wenhao Yang, Hongsen Niu, Weidong Wang, Liu Wang, Wenhao Zhu, Di Chen, Tingrui Pan, Chuan Fei Guo, Guozhen Shen
The emerging flexible iontronic sensing (FITS) technology offers a novel approach to tactile perception, mimicking human skin's structure and enabling seamless integration with biological systems. This review highlights its latest advancements.
